headline: Unite Group Restructures Leadership Team to Cut Operating Costs
summary: UK student accommodation provider Unite Group announced a restructuring of its executive leadership team aimed at reducing corporate administrative expenses.
why: Unite Group is the UK's largest owner and developer of student accommodation real estate, listed on the FTSE 100.

impacts.name: Unite Group PLC
impacts.why: Leadership restructuring aims to trim overhead operational costs.
